ai_analysis.summary: Out of 75,148 CVEs ranked from 2024-2025, 32 KEV additions were caught within the top 517, while 43 were missed. The missed CVEs had lower average feature values for indicators like public exploit code, GitHub proof-of-concept, and CVSS base score. The pattern suggests that the model relied heavily on these features to rank CVEs, potentially overlooking other important factors.
